title: universal-modder gives coding agents a ten-step loop for modding games, and a notebook they write for each other
summary: universal-modder packages skills, a CLI and the fal MCP server so an agent can recon, reverse-engineer and mod a PC game, then leave a field note for the next agent. How the loop works: https://github.com/rehan-remade/universal-modder
image_prompt: A cluttered workbench in front of a monitor showing a pixel-art game world, where a small robot carefully copies a save file into a labeled backup box before opening the game's casing, and a thick shared notebook of handwritten field notes lies open beside it.
